title: Provider-neutral Model Infrastructure Manager for text, image, voice and cloud ML
observation: Operator explicitly requested a plug-and-play model/compute layer that automatically researches new models, intelligently routes between subscription, API, open-weight and abliterated models, manages cloud GPU capacity such as RunPod, supports image/voice workloads and ML/LoRA training, and quotes/budgets work before paid execution.
suspected_root_cause: Current routing is provider/model aware but does not yet own cloud compute lifecycle, multimodal/training workloads, live pricing, quote/budget planning, or a continuous plug-and-play model catalog.
suggested_direction: Implement the phased roadmap in model-infrastructure-manager.md. Extend existing routing/CAP/eval/research primitives; add provider-neutral workload/capability/compute/secret/artifact contracts, a RunPod-first adapter, shadow abliterated foreman evaluation, continuous model research, and image/audio/training support.
acceptance: New text/code models can be added without scheduler changes
Image and voice/audio models are first-class capability types
RunPod can be quoted and later provisioned through a provider-neutral compute interface
Paid jobs respect hard project/job budgets and approval gates
Credentials are configured locally and never committed
Training/LoRA requests produce intelligent low/expected/high quotes before launch
Abliterated foreman routing can be evaluated in shadow mode against incumbent routes
Continuous research can discover and benchmark future model releases
risks: Provider APIs and model metadata change quickly; adapters and research records must be versioned
An experimental/abliterated foreman must not become the authorization or spending boundary
Cloud idle time, retries and artifact storage can create hidden cost if not included in quotes
notes: High priority. Begin with no-cost schema/eval/quote infrastructure; paid compute remains approval/budget gated.
